svg.title: BlooglyBlob head bearing film template: actual size

g.text: Print at 100% (actual size). Turn off Fit, Shrink and Scale to page.
Check the 50 mm bar before cutting clear film about 0.17–0.19 mm thick.
Cut the solid lines. Fold both tabs down 90° along the dashed lines.
Lay the disc on the collar and insert the tabs into its two slots.
Outer diameter 82.6 mm · inner circle 62 mm · tabs 3.2 mm wide, 2.5 mm deep
